about: Golden cases of the V/F voltage model (R-B4), shared by the desktop UI (desktop/app/ui/tests/golden_voltage.test.mjs) and the Python helper. See README.md here.

encoding.offset_raw: sign(mV) * ((|mV| * 1024 + 512) // 1000), 11-bit two's complement in [31:21]; mV of a raw = raw * 1000 / 1024

cases.title: a point at -20 mV with a whole-curve -30 mV runs -50 mV; the whole-curve edit writes only the P2 = 0 word
evidence: [MEASURED lnx 2026-10-11/12] the P2 = 0 offset [31:21] shifts every point, additive to the per-point offsets (platform-arl-s.md §3; tuning-results.md §5-6)
[DOC coreboot oc_mailbox.h] V/F word: ratio [7:0], target [19:8] U12.2.10, mode [20], offset [31:21] S11; [DECOMPILED ThrottleStop] mV->raw (|mV|*1024+512)//1000 (registers.md)
